# --- Mã giảm giá ---
import pytest
from shop.pricing import calc_discount


def make_coupon_order(code, province="HN", price=100000, qty=2):
    o = make_order(province, price, qty)
    o.coupon_code = code
    return o


def test_no_coupon_no_discount():
    assert calc_discount(make_order()) == 0


def test_percent_coupon():
    assert calc_discount(make_coupon_order("GIAM10")) == 20000


def test_fixed_coupon():
    assert calc_discount(make_coupon_order("GIAM50K")) == 50000


def test_discount_capped_at_subtotal():
    assert calc_discount(make_coupon_order("GIAM50K", price=10000, qty=1)) == 10000


def test_invalid_coupon_raises():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        calc_discount(make_coupon_order("KHONGCO"))


def test_total_vat_after_discount():
    # 200.000 - 20.000 = 180.000; VAT 14.400; ship HN 20.000
    assert calc_total(make_coupon_order("GIAM10")) == 180000 + 14400 + 20000


def test_free_ship_uses_original_subtotal():
    # tạm tính 600.000 > 500.000 -> miễn ship dù sau giảm còn 550.000
    assert calc_total(make_coupon_order("GIAM50K", price=300000, qty=2)) == 550000 + 44000
EOF
